title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy journey. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are beneficial for pregnant women, helping to build a balanced and nutritious diet.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and reducing the risk of constipation.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of bones and teeth for the baby.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, supporting the development of the fetus.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of the baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting the development of the fetus.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting the immune system and reducing the risk of disease.

## Combining Foods to Build Balanced Meals
To build balanced meals, pregnant women can combine these international pantry staples with other foods. For example:
- Breakfast: oatmeal with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: salad with lentils, eggs, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: lentil soup with leafy greens and citrus.

## Food Safety Considerations
Pregnant women need to be mindful of food safety when preparing and consuming these international pantry staples. Some important considerations:
- Cook food thoroughly before consumption.
- Avoid consuming raw or undercooked food.
- Wash hands and utensils before handling food.

## Conclusion
International pantry staples can help pregnant women build a balanced and nutritious diet. By combining these staples with other foods and being mindful of food safety, expectant mothers can support the health and well-being of both themselves and their babies.
